description: This file contains unit tests for the QpackDecoder component of the QUIC protocol implementation, focusing on header decoding, dynamic table management, error handling, and stream interactions.

classes.name: QpackDecoderTest
classes.description: Unit test fixture for testing the QpackDecoder component, parameterized by FragmentMode, with setup for decoding, error handling, and stream interactions.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Decodes a complete header block from the given data, handling setup, decoding, and end signals.

methods.name: DecodeData
methods.description: Decodes header data in fragments according to the current fragment mode.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes decoding by creating a new progressive decoder.

methods.name: EndDecoding
methods.description: Signals the end of header decoding to the progressive decoder.

methods.name: CreateProgressiveDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new QpackProgressiveDecoder for a given stream ID.

methods.name: DecodeEncoderStreamData
methods.description: Feeds encoder stream data into the decoder.
